parentFallback.residentBackdrop: nearest available ancestor retained even after a fine target arrives
parentFallback.preparedRam: nearest prepared ancestor restored for ideal leaves, even when fine GPU tiles are ready; fallback requests do not recursively restore more backgrounds
parentFallback.uploadAdmission: ancestors of current targets admitted and prioritized; unrelated demand pruned
parentFallback.eviction: owners protected; oldest nonowners or detail with resident ancestor evicted first
